Aphelios.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps to withstand Aphelios’s main source of physical damage. If his healing can turn the fight, finish one core item, then buy Executioner's Calling and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. If roots keep stopping your engages, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Aphelios.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to combine the Plasma detonation with your damage. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and back off. For an all-in, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, stack Plasma with basic attacks, and finish with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Aphelios.escape: Delay your engage while Aphelios can use Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites after slowing you with Gravitum. Look for an opening after he has used his root and other tools to fight back, and when he isn’t holding Severum either. Mark him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the gap with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Aphelios.fight: Trade when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. When Aphelios is away from the wave, use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to focus the missiles. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only target marked enemies, so use it to finish him off or adjust your angle after Aphelios’s tools to fight back are down.
Aphelios.laning: When Aphelios has Calibrum, back off so its mark doesn’t keep chipping away at your health. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to clear a weakened wave only when you need to push before recalling or setting up vision.
Aphelios.phase: Kai'Sa is weak early, so avoid trading blows with Aphelios and minimize losses until your first core item. In the mid game, use the ability evolutions unlocked by completing core items, and take the initiative after your second core item. Keep checking Aphelios’s weapons and your engage angle in the late game too.
Aphelios.teamfight: Start from the back by marking Aphelios with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and spread out so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several allies. Once the enemy’s immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Before going in, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, move out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites can root you. Back off when marked by Calibrum to avoid the follow-up attack. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil deals more damage to clustered targets when it hits champions, so keep your distance from allies.

Ashe.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Ashe.combo: When Ashe W Volley is down, poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Build stacks with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, add a basic attack, then time Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to hit as Plasma detonates. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility spell to create distance, so approach when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge. Use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to engage only after marking Ashe with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack.
Ashe.fight: Try to trade right after Ashe W Volley is down, and keep your distance until Ashe Q Ranger's Focus wears off if it is active. When Ashe is away from the minions, use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain so its damage doesn’t get split. To engage, close the gap with Kai'Sa E Supercharge; if a mark remains, follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after Ashe has used her tools to fight back.
Ashe.laning: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, then chip away at her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker after it is down. When you need to push before recalling or setting up vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Ashe.phase: Kai'Sa is weak early, so avoid trading blows with Ashe and minimize losses until your first core item. Kai'Sa gets stronger with each completed core item and can take the initiative after the second. Even in the late game, don’t force an engage while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available.
Ashe.teamfight: Start by marking Ashe with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker from the back. Once Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and the enemy’s immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle and approach Ashe. Detonate Plasma with a basic attack, and check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways; it is an area slow. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with each basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stun you, so change direction instead of running in a straight line.

Caitlyn.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Get Quicksilver Sash earlier if you’re at high risk of being caught while rooted by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.
Caitlyn.combo: Poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off. From a distance, mark Caitlyn with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, confirm her tools to fight back are down, then follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Caitlyn.escape: Secure a route that avoids Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. Once the tools to fight back are down, engage with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct on a target you have marked with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for an opening right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave. When poking, only fire Kai'Sa W Void Seeker when you can hit, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Caitlyn is away from the minion wave so the missiles don’t spread out.
Caitlyn.laning: If Caitlyn pushes the lane, don’t force your way forward; farm under your turret. When recalling or moving to set up vision, evenly weaken the minions, then clear the wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early lane, so focus on farming and avoid giving up kills. You grow stronger with each completed core item and can take the initiative after your second core item.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Start from the back and wait, marking Caitlyn with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. Once the enemy frontline’s immobilizing abilities and engage tools, along with Caitlyn’s tools to fight back, have been used, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack. Before going in, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape.
Caitlyn.watch: When Caitlyn pokes with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions so they take the hit first. If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you’ll be rooted and take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot’s increased range, so avoid traps in bushes and narrow paths.

Draven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Draven’s main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Also consider your total health because of the execute threshold on Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: Hit Draven with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker where an axe will land, then stack Plasma with a basic attack and follow with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q and back off. For a long-range engage, mark him with W, then close in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after Draven E Stand Aside is down, finishing with a basic attack and Q.
Draven.escape: Draven has no spell to create distance, but Draven E Stand Aside can disrupt your engage, so go in after it is down. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only target enemies with a Plasma mark, so mark Draven first with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack.
Draven.fight: Don’t trade blows while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe stacks. Aim Kai'Sa W Void Seeker at the spot where he will catch an axe, and fight when he has one or fewer axes or Draven E Stand Aside is down. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Draven is away from the minions so its damage doesn’t get split.
Draven.laning: If Draven pushes the lane, don’t force your way forward; your jungler can target Draven when he steps up. Before recalling or moving to set up vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Draven.phase: Draven is strong early while holding his axes, so Kai'Sa should focus on farming without falling behind until her first core item. Kai'Sa gets stronger with each completed core item and can take the initiative after her second. The available data isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game, but shutting Draven down early can reduce his accumulated stacks and later damage.
Draven.teamfight: Don’t jump in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct right away; start by marking Draven with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker from the back. Once Draven E Stand Aside and the enemy’s tools to fight back are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and R to find an angle, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack. Don’t rely on R’s shield alone when engaging; check that E is available to escape.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe stacks, since his empowered basic attacks hit hard. Draven E Stand Aside slows and displaces you, so make sure it is down before engaging. Draven R Whirling Death is dangerous on its return path too, so after dodging it once, get completely clear of its path in both directions.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize completing your first core item to reach the power spike when Kai'Sa’s ability evolutions unlock. The data doesn’t specify exact items, but if you need resistances, account for both the physical damage from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and the magic damage from Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift.
Ezreal.combo: For a short trade, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Once Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, stack Plasma with basic attacks, then finish with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Ezreal.escape: The window to engage opens right after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. If you’ve already marked him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, you can close the gap with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, but repeated hits from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot make that window shorter.
Ezreal.fight: Hit Ezreal with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to mark him and force him to use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then engage. When Ezreal is away from the minions, use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to reduce the damage lost to missiles spreading out.
Ezreal.laning: Pull the wave early and farm safely, using minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to poke only when you can hit. If you need to push before recalling, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Ezreal.phase: The available data isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Ezreal.teamfight: Start from the back by marking Ezreal with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then look for an angle to close the gap after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. If you can get close, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to position, then finish with basic attacks and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Before using Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to engage, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape.
Ezreal.watch: If Ezreal Q Mystic Shot keeps hitting you, Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes back up faster, so dodge with minions between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range to avoid the follow-up damage. When your health is low, retreat along terrain to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Jhin.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Jhin’s main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Get Quicksilver Sash earlier if the enemy composition can lock Kai'Sa down and kill her.
Jhin.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q and back off. If Jhin is reloading and away from the minions, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, stack Plasma with basic attacks, then finish with Q. From a distance, mark him with W, then follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after Jhin W Deadly Flourish and his other tools to fight back are down, finishing with basic attacks and Q.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no spell to create distance, so reloading or having just fired his final shot creates an opening to engage. Once Jhin W Deadly Flourish and other immobilizing abilities are down, close the gap on the marked Jhin with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Jhin.fight: Avoid trading blows while Jhin’s final shot is available. Close the gap while he is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Jhin is away from the minions so the missiles spread out less. After applying a Plasma mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to finish him or adjust your angle when Jhin’s root and other tools to fight back are down.
Jhin.laning: Stay away from low-health minions because Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can bounce to you. When you need to push before recalling or setting up vision, weaken the minions with basic attacks, then clear the wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Jhin.teamfight: Start from the back by marking Jhin with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and advance after your frontline has taken Jhin’s attacks and traps. Once Jhin W Deadly Flourish and other immobilizing abilities are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack. Jhin R Curtain Call is especially dangerous to low-health allies, so dodge it; if someone needs to block a shot, the ally with the highest health percentage should do so.
Jhin.watch: Back off while Jhin P Whisper’s final shot is available, since it deals heavy damage. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can grow stronger when it bounces from a target it kills, so stand away from low-health minions. After being hit by a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. If your health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on missing health, especially its final shot.
Jhin.phase: Kai'Sa can take the initiative in fights after her second core item, but the information provided isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late game.

Jinx.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Jinx’s main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Get Quicksilver Sash earlier if the enemy composition can lock Kai'Sa down and kill her.
Jinx.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q and back off. For an all-in, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, stack Plasma with basic attacks, then finish with Q. To engage from a distance, mark Jinx with W first and follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after her tools to fight back are down.
Jinx.escape: The window to engage opens when Jinx W Zap! misses or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. Jinx has no spell to create distance, so if a mark remains, you can close the gap with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Don’t start a fight right after an ally dies or a turret falls, because Jinx P Get Excited! activates then.
Jinx.fight: While Jinx pokes with rockets, she has no minigun attack speed stacks, so look for a chance to close in. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or is down, close the gap with Kai'Sa E Supercharge. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Jinx is away from the wave.
Jinx.laning: If Jinx pushes the lane, don’t force your way forward, and stand away from minions so you don’t get hit by her rocket attacks too. Only clear a weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when you need to push before recalling or setting up vision.
Jinx.phase: Kai'Sa scales with completed items rather than levels, so survive until your first core item and take the initiative after your second. The available data isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game, and you should avoid fighting right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: Don’t jump in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct right away; start by marking Jinx with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker from the back. After Jinx W Zap! misses or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, and the enemy’s immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and R. Before engaging, check that E is available to escape, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks also damage targets around minions, so don’t stand beside minions being last-hit. Jinx E Flame Chompers! can root and stop your engage, so go in after the traps are down. When health has been reduced, stay out of the finishing range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!

Kalista.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Kalista’s physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps and build armor first.
Kalista.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, but use Q when Kalista is away from the minions. For an all-in, close the gap with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, stack Plasma with basic attacks, then follow with Q.
Kalista.escape: Look for an opening after Kalista R Fate's Call is down and her bound support has finished engaging. You can follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct only after marking Kalista with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack. If Kalista is caught by an ally’s immobilizing abilities, engage then, since it’s hard for her to escape with a hop.
Kalista.fight: Avoid early trades. When Kalista is away from the wave, hit her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to start a trade. Read the moment she starts a basic attack and fire W then; if it misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off.
Kalista.laning: Pull the wave and farm safely while poking with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. If your health gets low while Kalista’s spears are stacked in you, leave the lane. When recalling or moving to set up vision, evenly weaken the minions, then clear the wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Kalista.phase: Use the timing when core items unlock ability evolutions, and take the initiative after your second core item.
Kalista.teamfight: Start from the back by marking Kalista with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. If Kalista looks ready to throw her support with Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out first. After the enemy’s engage and immobilizing abilities have been used on your frontline, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, then detonate Plasma with a basic attack. Before using R to engage, check that E is available to escape.
Kalista.watch: Watch out for the damage when Kalista detonates the spears she has stacked with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks using Kalista E Rend. If several spears are lodged in you, stop fighting and leave the lane until they disappear. Spread out when her bound support stays close, in anticipation of Kalista R Fate's Call.

KogMaw.build: Play to minimize losses until your first core item is complete, then use the skill evolutions it unlocks. Build magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, while also getting some armor to account for his basic attack damage. Avoid relying on health alone, since Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your max health.
KogMaw.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and back off if W misses. For an all-in, approach with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, then layer Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last. From long range, mark Kog'Maw with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after his retaliation is down.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility spell, so look for an opening after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down. Dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, then close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge. If you've marked him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, follow up with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
KogMaw.fight: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and close the distance. Kog'Maw has no mobility spell, so use Kai'Sa E Supercharge to get in and land basic attacks. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Kog'Maw is away from the wave. Use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to finish off a marked Kog'Maw or adjust your angle.
KogMaw.laning: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, back off and wait it out; look to trade after it ends. When you need to push for a recall or vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
KogMaw.phase: Kai'Sa is weak early, so farm safely and minimize losses until your first core item. You get stronger with each completed item, and can start taking the initiative against Kog'Maw from your second core item onward. Kog'Maw gets stronger over time, so secure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game to speed up the game.
KogMaw.teamfight: Start from the back by marking Kog'Maw with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then engage after the enemy's immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline. If Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has ended and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle on him. Before engaging, make sure Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape. After taking down Kog'Maw, get out of range of the Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise explosion.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and damage based on your max health increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces your armor and magic resistance, so block it with minions or dodge it; if it hits, don't fight right away. When your health is low, avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery by moving out of vision. After taking down Kog'Maw, walk away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Lucian's main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain so Kai'Sa P Second Skin's Plasma detonates after the target has taken damage. If W misses, save Q too and back off. For an all-in, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, build Plasma with basic attacks, and layer Q last when Lucian is away from the wave.
Lucian.escape: The opening to engage is right after you bait out Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Kai'Sa E Supercharge charges slowly early, so don't engage recklessly while counting on it as an escape.
Lucian.fight: Dodge Lucian's first combo and two empowered shots, then retaliate when his abilities are down. The brief window right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is a chance to close the distance, but extended basic attack trades let E come back quickly, so focus your attacks into that opening. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Lucian is away from minions so the missiles don't spread out.
Lucian.laning: When Lucian hits minions with Q Piercing Light, move out of the line behind them, and only fire W when you're confident it will hit. When you need to push for a recall or vision, damage the minions first, then clear them with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Lucian.phase: Kai'Sa gets stronger from completing items more than from gaining levels, so take the initiative after your second core item is complete. Even late game, wait for the enemy's engage and counterattack tools to be used before finding an angle instead of leading with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Lucian.teamfight: Start from the back by marking the enemy with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then move in after the enemy frontline has used immobilizing abilities and engage tools on your frontline. Use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then detonate Plasma with basic attacks. Don't engage relying only on R's shield; make sure E is available to escape.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its indicated range, so don't stand directly behind a target minion when he farms with Q. Avoid trading when Lucian P Lightslinger can fire its two empowered shots. When Lucian uses R The Culling, he can't change its aim, so sidestep instead of running straight back.

MissFortune.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and Miss Fortune R Bullet Time deal mainly physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and save Q and back off if W misses. When you get a chance to close in, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, and layer Q last. To engage from long range with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, mark Miss Fortune first with W or a basic attack.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so look for a chance to close the distance after leaving the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, don't only back away; use Kai'Sa E Supercharge to move beside its cone. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only target a marked enemy, so mark them in advance and use R to finish them off or adjust your engage angle.
MissFortune.fight: Avoid trading damage early, and only poke when you can hit Miss Fortune with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. When Miss Fortune is away from the wave, Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain's missiles won't spread out, making it a good time to trade. After closing the distance, build Plasma with basic attacks and detonate it after the target has taken damage.
MissFortune.laning: Let the wave push toward you so you can farm safely. After Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid her next empowered basic attack. Stand beside minions instead of directly behind one to avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up. If you need to push before recalling or setting up vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
MissFortune.phase: From mid game onward, use the skill evolutions unlocked by completed items, and start taking the initiative from your second core item onward.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don't engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is on the ground; draw her out of the area. Start from the back by marking her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle after her counterattack ability has been used. To dodge Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, move beside its fixed cone, and make sure E is available to escape before engaging.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off minions and hits Kai'Sa when she stands behind one, so don't stand in line with a minion. Move out of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain's area so you don't get hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time while slowed. When the ultimate starts, its cone direction is fixed, so use the movement speed from Kai'Sa E Supercharge to sidestep.

Nilah.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Nilah's main damage is physical, build armor first, but get health as well to account for Nilah Q Formless Blade's penetration. If her healing can turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Nilah.combo: When poking, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and save Q if W misses. For an all-in after Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, close the gap with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, then layer Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last.
Nilah.escape: Look for an opening when Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down. Nilah E Slipstream can be used again, so it's safer to go in after an ally immobilizes her. Use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after marking Nilah with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, once her counterplay is down, to find an angle or finish her off.
Nilah.fight: Only fire Kai'Sa W Void Seeker when you're confident it will hit. If it misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back away. After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends and Nilah E Slipstream is down, build Plasma with basic attacks and fight. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Nilah is away from minions so its damage isn't spread out.
Nilah.laning: Keep the wave pulled toward your side and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, but create more distance right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to clear the weakened wave only when you need to push for a recall or vision.
Nilah.phase: Kai'Sa gets stronger with completed items more than with levels, so fight carefully before your first core item and take the initiative after your second. The available information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger late game.
Nilah.teamfight: If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies so several of you aren't pulled in together. From the back line, mark Nilah with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. After Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Before going in, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to get back out.
Nilah.watch: Step back after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, since it increases her attack range and area. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, Kai'Sa's basic attacks miss, so stop attacking and wait for it to end. Spread out so Nilah R Apotheosis does not pull several allies in together.

Samira.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira's main damage is physical and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, attack with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off. For an all-in, close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Samira is away from the wave.
Samira.escape: If no one dies after Samira E Wild Rush is used, the dash doesn't reset immediately, creating an opening to engage. After confirming the enemy's immobilizing abilities and Samira W Blade Whirl are down, mark her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Samira.fight: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, hit her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and build Plasma with basic attacks. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Samira is away from the wave so the missiles don't spread out among minions. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only target a marked enemy, so mark her and use R to finish her off or adjust your angle after her retaliation is down.
Samira.laning: Limit the time Samira can walk up and stay in melee range, and don't step forward to trade when the enemy pushes the lane. Only clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when you need to push for a recall or vision.
Samira.phase: Take the initiative after your second core item, but keep track of Samira's engage and ultimate requirements in the late game as well.
Samira.teamfight: Don't lead with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct; start from the back by marking Samira with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. After the enemy's immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then detonate Plasma with basic attacks. If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush to engage and no one has died, that's an opening to attack. Retreat together so no low-health ally is left behind.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is active, it destroys projectiles, so use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and basic attacks after the spin ends. If you're hit by the enemy's immobilizing abilities, Samira can dash in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge their engage ability first. If Samira gets close, varies her attacks, and builds Style, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so create distance to interrupt her attacks.

Senna.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness is enough to turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Senna.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q too and back off. For an all-in, close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build stacks with basic attacks, and layer Q last when Senna is away from the wave.
Senna.escape: The chance to close the distance comes when Senna W Last Embrace misses or after she uses it to root someone. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, back off first and look for another angle from a spot with vision. To engage with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, mark Senna first with a basic attack or Kai'Sa W Void Seeker.
Senna.fight: Avoid trading damage before your first core item, and poke Senna with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker when she steps forward to collect a soul. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Senna is away from the wave so its damage doesn't spread out.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna's souls are, and disrupt her collection by poking with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker when she steps up to collect one. Only clear weakened minions with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when you need to push the lane.
Senna.phase: Take the initiative after your second core item is complete, and watch out late game for the extra range and attack damage Senna gains from collecting souls.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness heals and slows, so move out of the line between Senna and the minion in front of you. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits, move away from your allies before the root detonates. After Senna hits you once, back off to avoid taking a second hit and deny her Mist collection.
Senna.teamfight: At first, stay back and apply Plasma with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back off and move somewhere with vision, or cast Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain into the mist. Once the enemy uses their immobilizing ability and engage tool on your frontline, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then trigger the stacks with basic attacks.

Seraphine.build: Prioritize completing Kai'Sa's first core item, and build magic resistance against Seraphine's magic damage before armor. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound is enough to turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling after your first core item, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. If the enemy composition can catch and kill Kai'Sa with immobilizing abilities, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Seraphine.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to layer Plasma damage. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off. To engage, mark Seraphine first, then use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, and finish with basic attacks and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility spell, so the opening to engage comes right after you avoid Seraphine E Beat Drop. Use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to approach a target marked with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack. If Seraphine still has counterattack tools available, don't rush the dash.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is standing alone, away from her allied ranged damage dealer. After dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge. If Seraphine is away from the wave, use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Kai'Sa's physical damage is effective against Seraphine's low armor.
Seraphine.laning: When Seraphine is with her allies, watch for basic attacks empowered by Seraphine P Stage Presence, and try to trade when she is alone. Only clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when you need to push for a recall or vision.
Seraphine.phase: Kai'Sa gets stronger from completing items more than from gaining levels, so play carefully until your first core item and take the initiative from your second core item onward. In late-game teamfights, wait to engage with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct if Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore are still available.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to either side to avoid Seraphine R Encore extending through champions in a line. Start from the back by marking Seraphine with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle after Seraphine E Beat Drop and the enemy's engage tools are down. Before going in, make sure Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape, then detonate Plasma with basic attacks.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets, so move out from directly in front of her if you're slowed. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits a champion, so don't stand in a line with your allies. Carefully calculate your finishing damage while Seraphine W Surround Sound's shield and healing are still available.

Sivir.build: Sivir's main damage is physical, and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Sivir's healing is enough to turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back off. For an all-in, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Sivir is away from minions.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no blink mobility spell, so the opening to catch her comes when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. After Sivir R On The Hunt ends, mark her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Before using Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to engage, make sure Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to escape.
Sivir.fight: Avoid trading damage early, and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker after Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Sivir is away from the minion wave so its damage doesn't spread out. When you get a good chance to close the distance, build Plasma with basic attacks and detonate it after the target has taken damage.
Sivir.laning: Before your first core item, let the wave push toward you and farm safely to avoid falling behind. Don't force a trade by stepping forward even if Sivir pushes the lane. If you need to leave lane, push the wave beforehand or make sure an ally is ready to catch it. When pushing, clear weakened minions with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Sivir.phase: Sivir clears waves quickly, so focus on farming safely until your first core item. In mid game, Kai'Sa gets stronger with each completed core item, and can take the initiative after her second core item. The available information doesn't establish who has the advantage late game, so look for the moment the enemy's abilities are down before engaging in teamfights.
Sivir.teamfight: Don't lead with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct; start from the back by marking Sivir with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. After Sivir E Spell Shield is down and the enemy's immobilizing abilities and engage tools have been used on your frontline, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle on Sivir. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, only take short fights using terrain and vision, and detonate Plasma with basic attacks after engaging.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the way out and the return, so if the first hit lands, step out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check that the shield is down before using Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, don't chase the faster enemy team for long.

Smolder.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Smolder's damage is mainly physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! is enough to turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Smolder.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and save Q and back off if W misses. For an all-in after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, and layer Q last. If Smolder is among minions, Q missiles will spread out, so look for a moment when he's away from the wave.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so the moment it's down is your opening to engage. Mark him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after his counterattack tools are down. If Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands at your feet, don't follow him into it; step outside before closing in again.
Smolder.fight: Avoid forced trades before Kai'Sa's first core item, and take more fights as you complete items. When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and build Plasma with basic attacks. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Smolder is away from the wave so the missiles spread out less.
Smolder.laning: Dodge Smolder W Achooo! while disrupting his last-hitting and growth stacks, then pressure him after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down. When you need to recall or set up vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Smolder.phase: Minimize losses before your first core item while disrupting Smolder's farming, and take the initiative from your second core item onward. Smolder gains the advantage over time, so take objectives and turrets quickly in mid game.
Smolder.teamfight: Don't lead with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct; start from the back by marking Smolder with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. After Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap and the enemy's immobilizing abilities and engage tools are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and R to find an angle, then detonate Plasma with basic attacks. Don't engage relying only on R's shield; make sure E is available to escape.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! slows you on hit and also gives him growth stacks, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. As Smolder grows, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains true damage and an execute, so be especially careful at low health. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so step out of the flames before closing in again.

Tristana.combo: Poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back away. To engage, first leave a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after Tristana's counterplay is down, and finish with basic attacks and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Tristana.escape: The moment after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to close the distance. If Tristana R Buster Shot is also down and you've applied a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, follow her in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Decide first whether to save Kai'Sa E Supercharge to escape after going in.
Tristana.fight: Early on, avoid trading hits, and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker when Tristana is away from the minions. If it hits, build Kai'Sa P Second Skin Plasma with basic attacks and follow up with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Look for an engage after Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are down.
Tristana.laning: Before your first core item, pull the wave and farm safely, and don't force your way forward even if Tristana pushes the lane. Keep your distance from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. When you need to push, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, then recall or establish vision.
Tristana.phase: Kai'Sa gets stronger as she completes items, so fight cautiously before your first core item and take the initiative after your second. A fully built Tristana is difficult to handle, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Start from the back by applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and don't jump in first while Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. Once her counterplay is down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then trigger Plasma with basic attacks. If an ally falls, Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, so back away immediately and don't leave fragile allies in front.
Tristana.watch: Don't stand close to allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Tristana W Rocket Jump slows and resets when she gets a takedown, so back away immediately if an ally falls during a team fight. Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you away, so don't engage recklessly while it's available.

TwistedFate.build: Minimize losses until your first core item is complete, then focus on completing core items to unlock Kai'Sa's ability evolutions. Build magic resistance against damage from Twisted Fate's abilities, and consider movement speed to help you leave the areas he telegraphs.
TwistedFate.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain if Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses. When all-inning after Twisted Fate uses his Gold Card, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build stacks with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last. From a distance, apply a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then go in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after his counterplay is down.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's Gold Card is used is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate holds a Gold Card, and close in while he holds a Blue or Red Card, or just after he uses the Gold Card. Hit him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to apply a mark, then use basic attacks to build stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin. When Twisted Fate is away from the wave, use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain so the missiles don't scatter.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, pull the wave and farm safely while poking with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. Stand behind minions against Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and stay outside his attack range when his Gold Card is ready. When recalling or going to establish vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Start from the back by applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and watch to see whether Twisted Fate uses his Gold Card. After the enemy's immobilizing effects and engage tools have been used on your frontline, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then trigger Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks with basic attacks. Before going in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, make sure Kai'Sa E Supercharge is still available to escape.
TwistedFate.watch: Twisted Fate W Pick a Card can lock in a Gold Card that stuns with one basic attack, so stay outside his attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce the poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.phase: After her second core item, Kai'Sa should initiate fights, choosing a moment when the yellow card is down.

Twitch.build: In lane, use Control Wards to watch for Twitch Q Ambush, and minimize losses until your first core item is complete. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage together, and Twitch P Deadly Venom deals true damage, so building only one type of resistance won't make you safe.
Twitch.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and back away. In close fights, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge to close the distance, build stacks with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is revealed is your chance to engage. Leave a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, but make sure the enemy's counterattack abilities are down and that Kai'Sa E Supercharge can get you out.
Twitch.fight: When Twitch is away from the minions, hit him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to apply a mark and build Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks with basic attacks. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain from a position where the missiles won't scatter onto minions, after the enemy has taken damage.
Twitch.phase: Kai'Sa is weak early, so focus on farming safely instead of trading hits. Kai'Sa gets stronger with completed items rather than levels, so minimize losses before your first core item and take the initiative after your second. The available information isn't enough to judge a one-sided late-game advantage, so keep watching for the range and piercing attacks of Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, don't stand in a line with your allies; spread out to the sides of its attack direction. Wait while applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle after Twitch Q Ambush ends and the enemy's counterplay is down. Focus your attacks on Twitch and trigger Kai'Sa P Second Skin with basic attacks.
Twitch.watch: Move out immediately if Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet. With Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks on you, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even when you have around half health, so create distance before taking several basic attacks.

Varus.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Varus's main damage is physical, so build armor first, but armor won't stop the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver and Varus R Chain of Corruption. Buy Quicksilver Sash earlier if the enemy team can lock Kai'Sa down and pick her off.
Varus.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and back away while saving Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain if W misses. When closing the distance to fight, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge to get close, build Plasma with basic attacks, then use Q last. From a distance, apply a mark with W, then follow Varus in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after his root and counterattack are down.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to approach while he aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow or after he uses Varus R Chain of Corruption. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only be used on a marked target, so apply a mark first with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, and check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge can get you out before going in.
Varus.fight: Avoid trading hits early. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, sidestep its path and look for a chance to approach. Trade when Varus is away from minions: hit him with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then follow up with basic attacks and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Varus.laning: Before your first core item, focus on farming without losing ground. Pull the wave and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker. If Varus pushes the lane, don't trade hits up front; farm CS from behind. When you need to recall or establish vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Varus.phase: After your second core item is complete, take the initiative when Varus's root and counterattack are down.
Varus.teamfight: Start from the back by applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and keep your distance from allies so Varus R Chain of Corruption doesn't spread. Don't go in for a few seconds right after Varus gets stronger from a kill or assist. After the enemy's immobilizing effects and engage tools are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then trigger Plasma with basic attacks.
Varus.watch: Blight stacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver trigger max-health damage when hit by one of Varus's abilities. If you've taken a few basic attacks, back away and give the stacks time to disappear. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, keep your distance so the chains don't spread.

Vayne.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn, but don't keep taking hits, since armor can't reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Vayne.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to layer damage with the Plasma detonation. For an all-in, approach with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last. Against a distant Vayne, apply a mark first with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then follow her with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after her counterplay is down.
Vayne.escape: After Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble, if Vayne E Condemn is also down, you have a chance to engage. Leave a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, then close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. If Vayne E Condemn is still available, don't dash near a wall.
Vayne.fight: The moment after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the distance. Hit her with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to build Plasma, then trade with basic attacks and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Vayne is away from the minions. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back away.
Vayne.laning: If Vayne pushes the lane, farm CS from behind, and don't force Kai'Sa W Void Seeker onto her while she is hiding behind minions. When you need to push, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, then recall or establish vision.
Vayne.phase: Kai'Sa gets stronger when she completes core items, and should take the initiative after her second core item. As Vayne builds attack speed and penetration items in the late game, she becomes harder to handle, so secure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game.
Vayne.teamfight: Don't go in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct from the start; leave a mark on Vayne with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker from the back. Use the true sight from Kai'Sa W Void Seeker to reveal Vayne's position while Vayne R Final Hour makes her invisible. After Vayne E Condemn and her other counterplay are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle, then trigger Plasma with basic attacks in an open area.
Vayne.watch: If Vayne E Condemn knocks you into a wall, it stuns you, so don't fight with your back to a wall. Vayne W Silver Bolts needs repeated hits on the same target to trigger max-health true damage, so count the hits and create distance before it triggers.

Xayah.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Xayah's main damage is physical and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Quicksilver Sash earlier if the enemy team can lock Kai'Sa down and pick her off.
Xayah.combo: For a short trade, hit Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, then a basic attack, then Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q and back away. For an all-in, close the distance with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build stacks with basic attacks, then layer Q last.
Xayah.escape: The window after Xayah E Bladecaller root and Xayah R Featherstorm are down is your chance to engage. Only close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct after first applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack. Before using R, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is still available to escape.
Xayah.fight: Fighting in the same spot as Xayah for too long lets her stack feathers, so keep trades short and change position. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Xayah is away from the minions so the missiles don't scatter. Engage after Xayah E Bladecaller and Xayah R Featherstorm are down.
Xayah.laning: If Xayah pushes the lane, don't move forward to trade hits; farm CS from behind. When you need to push for a recall or vision, clear the weakened minions with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Xayah.phase: Take the initiative after your second core item, but delay your engage if Xayah R Featherstorm is still available.
Xayah.teamfight: Start from the back by applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and don't jump on Xayah first. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down and the enemy has used their immobilizing effects and engage abilities, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle. After going in, trigger Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks with basic attacks and follow up with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots if you are hit by three or more returning feathers, so move to the side immediately if feathers line up between you and Xayah. Don't go in first with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct while Xayah R Featherstorm is available.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical and Kai'Sa has low armor, so build armor first. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade's magic damage is not blocked by armor.
Yasuo.combo: Once you've broken the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer and have an angle to avoid Yasuo W Wind Wall, attack with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Build Plasma for Kai'Sa P Second Skin with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and basic attacks, then layer Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Yasuo is away from the wave. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses, save Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain too and back away.
Yasuo.escape: Look to go in just after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado is down, since he'll have no knock-up for a while. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again quickly, so don't go in just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes off cooldown, use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to close the gap on a marked Yasuo in sync with your allies' crowd control.
Yasuo.fight: Break the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer before committing to a damage trade. Look for an opening just after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado is down, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Yasuo is away from minions so the missiles don't spread out. Don't force a fight if Kai'Sa W Void Seeker misses or is likely to be blocked by Yasuo W Wind Wall.
Yasuo.laning: Pull the wave early and farm safely. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones, so keep a thin wave on your side to limit his approach options. Use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain to clear weakened minions only when you need to push for a recall or vision.
Yasuo.phase: Limit losses until your first core item, then take the initiative after your second core item by using your item power spike. The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage late game, so time your fights around Yasuo's tornado and W Wind Wall being down.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after hitting twice, so when its stacks are full, move off the line and dodge to the side. Be especially careful of the tornado, since a knock-up can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath. Save Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain in front of Yasuo W Wind Wall; go around it or wait for it to disappear.
Yasuo.teamfight: From the back line, apply a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, but avoid angles where Yasuo W Wind Wall can block it. Once there is less room to respond to Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado and engage, find an angle with Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, then detonate Kai'Sa P Second Skin's Plasma with basic attacks. Before using Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to go in, check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is available to get back out.

Zeri.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals max-health damage, so be careful about choosing to stack a lot of health alone.
Zeri.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If W misses, save Q too and back away. For an all-in after Zeri E Spark Surge is down, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build stacks with basic attacks, and use Q last when Zeri is away from the minions.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge is your window to engage. Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct can only be used on a marked target, so apply a mark first with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack. Go in with R after Zeri uses her counterplay, and check that Kai'Sa E Supercharge is still available to escape.
Zeri.fight: The moment after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge is your chance to close the distance. Leave a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, and use Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle once Zeri's counterplay is down. After closing in, build Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks with basic attacks, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Zeri is away from the wave.
Zeri.laning: Pull the wave and farm CS safely, and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker only when you can hit. Before recalling or establishing vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Zeri.phase: Use the power spike from ability evolutions after your first core item, and take the initiative from your second core item onward. Once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to catch, so look for moments when Zeri E Spark Surge or Zeri R Lightning Crash is down in the late game.
Zeri.teamfight: Don't jump in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct from the start; apply a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker from the back. If Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash, don't chase on foot. After the enemy's engage and counterplay are down, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and R to find an angle. Don't go deep relying only on R's shield; save E to get out.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don't stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so push her into open terrain when chasing her down. Zeri gains movement speed after activating Zeri R Lightning Crash, so don't chase on foot.

Ziggs.build: First, aim to complete a core item that meets the requirements for Kai'Sa's ability evolutions. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ziggs's magic damage, and consider movement speed to help you leave telegraphed attack areas.
Ziggs.combo: For poke, use Kai'Sa W Void Seeker → basic attack → Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, and save Q if W misses. Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and a path without mines is open, close in with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, build Plasma with basic attacks, then layer Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain last.
Ziggs.escape: Ziggs W Satchel Charge is his mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it for poke or wave clear is your window to engage. If you've left a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or a basic attack, close the distance with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct in that opening. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield blocks your path in, go around it or wait for it to disappear.
Ziggs.fight: The moment after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your chance to close the distance. Use Kai'Sa E Supercharge to approach from a direction without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain when Ziggs is away from the wave.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, pull the wave and farm CS safely, and poke with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker only when you can hit. Look for a trade after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities or spends Ziggs W Satchel Charge. When you need to push for a recall or vision, clear the weakened wave with Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Ziggs.phase: In the mid game, Kai'Sa gets stronger with each completed core item, and should take the initiative after her second core item when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. The available information isn't enough to judge who has the advantage late game, so enter team fights when Ziggs's counterplay is down.
Ziggs.teamfight: Start from the back by applying a mark with Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, and check for a path without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and the enemy's immobilizing effects and engage tools have been used, use Kai'Sa E Supercharge and Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to find an angle and trigger Plasma. In front of objectives, avoid grouping in one spot because of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Ziggs.watch: Stepping on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes it easier to get hit by the abilities that follow, so go around the mined path or wait for it to disappear. Dodge the landing spot of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, and move away from the center of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb's telegraphed area even if you can't get fully clear of it.
